description:
Performance task — adds a VPCLMULQDQ SIMD kernel for `Gf2mWide<4>` multiplication. Opt-in per the "within 2× of handwritten SIMD" criterion of the 6fb4abad story.

## Scope

- New `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/gf2m_wide.rs` with `unsafe` VPCLMULQDQ-based schoolbook for `N=4`. Plus scalar PCLMULQDQ fallback for hosts without VPCLMULQDQ.
- `pub re-export` in `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/lib.rs`.
- `pub type ClmulWide256Fn = unsafe fn(&[u64; 4], &[u64; 4], &mut [u64; 8])` with runtime detection via `detect()`. AVX512VL+VPCLMULQDQ path first (reference: existing `clmul_batch_vpclmul` at `crates/gf2-kernels-simd/src/x86/clmul.rs:130`).
- Dispatch hook in `crates/gf2-core/src/gf2m/wide.rs`: feature-gated fast-path in the `Mul` impl using the `OnceLock`+`detect()` pattern from `crates/gf2-core/src/lib.rs`.
- All `unsafe` stays in `gf2-kernels-simd`; `gf2-core` remains `#![deny(unsafe_code)]`.
- Criterion bench `crates/gf2-core/benches/gf2m_wide_mul.rs` comparing scalar vs SIMD.

## Success criteria

- Agreement test: scalar and SIMD paths match on 100 random inputs (when SIMD detected; `#[ignore]` otherwise).
- Benchmark recorded in PR body. Scalar within 2× of SIMD OR this task lands the SIMD path.
- `#[detect()]` returns `None` on hosts without PCLMULQDQ; scalar path used unconditionally.
- `cargo fmt`/`cargo clippy -- -D warnings`/`cargo test --release` clean.

## Depends on

Task 4 (correct scalar baseline), Task 5 (axiom coverage).

## Breakdown reference

See `dev/plans/6fb4abad_breakdown.md` Task 6.
title: VPCLMULQDQ SIMD kernel for GF(2^256) (opt-in)
